Figure 2:Overview.
(1) Tokenizer training: encoder, FSQ, and diffusion decoder are trained
jointly, with nested dropout so that the decoder can reconstruct the clip
from any token prefix.
SemanTok keeps this VideoFlexTok recipe (orange) and adds semantic supervision from a frozen teacher: its features enter the encoder, and every retained prefix is trained to predict them (purple; details infig.3).
(2) AR training and generation: with the tokenizer frozen, an AR model
learns to predict its tokens in time-first, coarse-to-fine order, and the
decoder trained in (1) renders any generated prefix as video.
